'''Umgullian blob gelatin''' was a lunch side at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Dex" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> The [[gelatin]]ous dish was sold for 4.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It shared its name with<ref name="Dex" /> the [[Umgullian blob]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the planet [[Umgul/Legends|Umgul]].<ref name="blob">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Umgullian blob gelatin was introduced in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" />
